maddeler.e:
نحتفل (form VIII)
# نَحْتَفِلُ (naḥtafilu) /naħ.ta.fi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# نُحْتَفَلُ (nuḥtafalu) /nuħ.ta.fa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# نَحْتَفِلَ (naḥtafila) /naħ.ta.fi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# نُحْتَفَلَ (nuḥtafala) /nuħ.ta.fa.la/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
